# NCAAF Saturday - Nov 7

Covers AI (Kalshi lines) vs Dimers win probabilities vs Kalshi. Dimers' listed spreads are openers; current lines used below.
- Iowa at Northwestern: opened NW -2.5; Covers AI Iowa 21-20, Dimers Iowa 55.8%, Predictem Iowa 21-17 - but the market flipped to Iowa ~56% (Kalshi), so the edge is gone. Pass.
- Miami at Notre Dame: ND -3.5 -> -7 after Miami WR Malachi Toney (1,027 yds, 13 TD) went out. Covers AI ND by 6, Dimers 72% (~7.5). On the number; pass.
- Oregon at Ohio State: OSU opened -14, now -7.5. Covers AI OSU by 14, Dimers 74.5% (~9) - both favor OSU but laying -7.5 is the hook through 7. Pass.
- Alabama at LSU (-5.5/-6.5): Covers AI LSU by 4, Dimers ~6, Kalshi "LSU by 6.5+" 49%. Alabama QB Jett Thomalla doubtful (backup-QB dog). Pass.
- Oklahoma at Florida (-6.5): Covers AI FLA by 3, Dimers ~6, Kalshi "FLA by 5.5+" 52%. OU QB Mateer possible benching, eight players out. Pass.
- BYU at Utah (-3.5/-4.5): Covers AI Utah by 11, Dimers ~4.5 - Utah -3.5 is the hook through 3. Pass.
- Georgia at Ole Miss (+3.5): Covers AI UGA by 1, Dimers ~3.5-4. Lean Ole Miss +3.5 only.
- Texas at Missouri, Kentucky at Tennessee, UCLA at Minnesota, Houston, Texas Tech, Boise: Covers AI and Dimers split or on the number. Pass.
No bets.


## 10:20 AM re-run (with leans)
New inputs: SportsLine model (CBS), CLEATZ handle splits, SBD line moves.

### Pick
- **Iowa ML at Northwestern (+115), 0.5u (night, Wrigley).** Books still have Northwestern -2.5 (moved from -1.5), but every projection has Iowa winning: Covers AI 21-20, Dimers 55.8%, Predictem 21-17, and Kalshi prices Iowa ~56%. Per the Tennessee lesson (road dog at +2.5 -> take the ML). ~53% after the 0.58 factor vs 46.5% implied. Small: Iowa's offense is the weak link (projections are all low-scoring).

### Leans (ranked)
1. Ohio State -7.5 vs Oregon - SportsLine >60% cover (double-digit win), Covers AI by 14, Dimers ~9. Three models, but it is the hook through 7, which the rules forbid. Play only at -7.
2. Oklahoma +6/+6.5 at Florida - SportsLine "well over 50%", Covers AI FLA by 3; Dimers/Kalshi on the number. QB Mateer benching unresolved (backup-QB dog risk).
3. Tennessee -6.5 vs Kentucky - SportsLine 27-19 (53%), Covers AI by 11, Dimers ~5.5. Under 49.5 SportsLine 62% but total fell below the opener.
4. Miami +7.5 at Notre Dame - Covers AI ND by 6; 82% of handle on Miami, yet the line moved to ND (reverse move = sharp ND). Conflicted.
5. Boston College +6.5 vs Florida State - 92% of handle on 26% of bets (big money gap); no model.
6. Ole Miss +3.5 vs Georgia - Covers AI UGA by 1, Dimers ~3.5.

picks.summary: Covers AI, Dimers, Predictem and Kalshi all have Iowa winning while books keep Northwestern -2.5.
